summary: Defines a general-purpose Document-Signing KeyPurposeId for the Extended Key Usage extension of X.509 certificates, building on the key purposes in RFC 5280. Document-signing applications can require the extension to mark certificates meant for signing documents. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: A certificate can carry a label saying what it may be used for. This adds a label for signing documents, so a signing app can pick the right ID.

questions: what is the document signing extended key usage
how to mark a certificate for document signing
